_comment: G5/G6 screening: centred PCA-192 of presence/absence; component 1 correlates 1.000 with depth. The reduction basis is fitted on that fold's four TRAINING folds only, so nothing crosses the fold boundary. Same hyperparameters, folds and protocol as the calibration refits, which ARE the full-space fraction baseline on exactly these folds. Hyperparameters were searched for the 110,202-dim fraction and are NOT re-searched, which handicaps every reduced arm. Score with 26_pooled_representation_test.py: pooled out-of-fold predictions, eligibility applied once, paired bootstrap over BioProjects -- never fold means. Held-out is not touched.
